title: LLMElicitedBehaviorBaseline.v1.PerModelResponse
description: Per-model elicitation output for a single monthly baseline call. The generator validates each provider's response against this schema before computing the multi-model intersection. The schema is embedded canonically inside the rendered user prompt so prompt_hash captures it.

lo.description: Lower bound of the plausible band for this attribute.

hi.description: Upper bound of the plausible band; must be strictly greater than lo.

mean.description: Central tendency within [lo, hi]. The generator may override this with (lo+hi)/2 during ensemble synthesis; provide your own estimate so per-model audit retains it.

std.description: One-sigma uncertainty for the attribute estimate. The generator may override this with (hi-lo)/4 during ensemble synthesis; provide your own estimate so per-model audit retains it.

rationale.description: Short prose justification (one to three sentences) explaining why this band is plausible for a general US adult viewer population. Cite the qualitative considerations you weighed; do not fabricate specific empirical numbers.
